title: Identify Actor Types
description: Place various actor types and explore their Components in the Details Panel.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Understand the variety of Actors and their components.

1. Open a new or existing level.
2. From the **Place Actors** panel, drag one of each into the viewport:
   - **Cube** (Basic)
   - **Point Light** (Lights)
   - **Player Start** (Basic)
   - **Trigger Volume** (Volumes)
3. Select each and observe its Components in the **Details Panel** (scroll to the bottom to see the component list).
   - The Cube has a Static Mesh Component.
   - The Point Light has a Light Component.
   - The Trigger Volume has a Brush Component.
4. In the **World Outliner**, note the **Type** column for each.
5. Rename each actor meaningfully (e.g., `TestCube`, `MainLight`).
hints: If you can’t find a Component list, look for the 'Components' header near the bottom of the Details Panel.
Player Start may only have a Scene Component (BillboardComponent).
expectedOutput: Four distinct actors placed, their components identified, and names customised.
